items.reader: Don't ship Ranker v7. The lift in Successful Search Rate is real but small: +0.0013 (0.4120 → 0.4133, 95% CI [+0.0005, +0.0020], p=0.0007). That is about a quarter of the pre-registered +0.005 bar, and even the top of the CI falls short. All four guardrails pass. **Current state:** the test ran its planned 14 days with 1M users per arm. The pulse is dated 2026-09-25 and still shows "active," and the readout did not analyse data after that date. Today is 2026-10-12, so it's unclear whether the test is still running. Don't ship v7 against this bar. If the team still wants the +0.1–0.2pp gain, treat it as a new decision with a lower bar, argued openly, not as a reinterpretation of this result. Before anything else, settle the experiment's status: stop it, or decide whether to analyse the data since 2026-09-25. Successful Search Rate change of +0.0013 (absolute, about +0.13 percentage points), against the +0.005 bar. The gain is well short of the bar, and the readout warns against lowering the bar after seeing the data. A second risk is the one nominally significant segment (navigational CTR, p=0.023), which is one of about 60 unplanned cuts and was treated as noise. Revenue per User is also close to its guardrail: its CI floor is about −0.8% against a −1% margin.
